scenes.image: Vertical: the whole crowd of Eden waiting by a tiny creek next to a giant ark, Adam holding a huge stack of boat tickets.
lines: [storybook] Everyone in Eden was waiting for the boat. The serpent said the creek was too dangerous.

scenes.image: a small white cartoon goat with a brown patch over one eye trotting down the ark's ramp with the passenger list in its mouth, Noah chasing.
a small white cartoon goat with a brown patch over one eye stepping into the creek while a crowd of fully clothed people in simple tunics watches from the bank, holding their breath.
a small white cartoon goat with a brown patch over one eye standing in water that barely reaches its knees, bored.
Eve turning to Adam, very quiet and very dangerous, Adam in his brown tunic sweating. No fruit anywhere.
lines: [very quiet] Adam. Did you ever check how deep it was?

scenes.image: Eve exploding with steam out of her ears.
lines: [exploding] You asked the guy SELLING THE BOAT TICKETS?!
